run.notes: PAIRED A/B, CPU ARM, ABBA. Context sweep at concurrency 1, 4 contexts x 2 output lengths, 3 repeats per pass, TWO passes per arm in ABBA order (CPU, GPU, GPU, CPU) so a linear thermal drift cancels between arms. Each pass started only after a >=120 s cooldown with the CPU package <=50 C and the GPU <=45 C (it reached 38-45 C every time). Figures are the mean of the two passes' per-cell medians; raw min/max span all 6 repeats. Both arms: llama.cpp f95b0d9 built 2026-09-22 under Debian sid (gcc 16.2, CUDA 13.4), identical flags except -ngl, including -t 6 -tb 12 on BOTH (the CPU arm's topology-derived values; the GPU arm's tpu.env says 4/8 and was overridden for parity - threads measured no effect on GPU decode on 2026-09-03). Prompt cache verified defeated: 0 of 28,553 prompt tokens cached in every pass. Host: Lenovo Yoga 9 15IMH5, i7-10750H 6C/12T, GTX 1650 Ti Max-Q, one shared thermal envelope; package throttle events rose 9,604 in CPU pass 1, 420 in GPU pass 1, 2,879 in GPU pass 2 and 19,279 in CPU pass 2. Page cache hot throughout (not a cold-start measurement). Arm attested from /proc on both passes: device=cpu, exe=/home/xbill/llama.cpp/build-cpu/bin/llama-server, sha256=9c88c7821fcc11a6. Supersedes nothing: 2026-09-16 was measured at c6824a9 with -t 4 -tb 8 in one CPU-then-GPU order and is not pairable with this run.

host.notes: 6 cores / 12 threads, homogeneous Comet Lake - NO P/E split; SMT siblings pair (0,6)...(5,11). avx2, NO avx_vnni, NO AVX-512. 15 GiB RAM. Lenovo Yoga 9 15IMH5, bare metal. No CPU affinity was set for this run; what that costs is unresolved - the prior llama-bench sweep that put it at 1.61x via E-core stragglers described a hybrid die this machine does not have, and is quarantined. CORRECTED 2026-09-22 (was: 12 cores / 16 threads, hybrid 4P+8E, avx_vnni).

model.architecture_notes: Reasoning model: tokens arrive as reasoning_content until the thinking block closes. sweep.py counts both. Only ~1.08 GB of the 3.33 GB artifact is Q4_0; both embeddings are Q6_K, and per_layer_token_embd (1.93 GB) is TENSOR_READ_LAZY.

workload.notes: decode-source auto -> stream; llama-server emits no usage.decode_tokens_per_second, so decode is client-side inter-token latency off the SSE stream. Prompts are device-neutral and identical across arms. prompt_mode=unique (per-request nonce first, so the prefix cache cannot hit). 6 = 3 repeats x 2 ABBA passes.

memory.notes: RssAnon 1,202,152 kB with the model loaded: llama.cpp repacks Q4_0 weights into an interleaved AVX2 layout, copying the body out of the mmap into anonymous memory. NOT re-measured in this run; carried from 2026-09-16 (c6824a9).
